args.prompt:
Create a NEW KFB claymation ink-blob sheet using the two attached original benchmarks solely for anatomy, clay surface, and sculpted eyes. Exactly six complete independent footless characters in three columns by two rows. Landscape 1536×1024 PNG. TRUE transparent alpha-zero background in all gaps and margins. No white matte, floor, vignette, scenery, large backdrop screens, shadow discs, labels, grid lines, real organization logos or national badges. Chemical Spill Containment crew. Shared kit: petrol-blue open-face protective helmets, mint seam tape, charcoal collars and small cream latches, clean industrial kit. Top row Assessment Detail, bottom row Recovery Detail. Each blob is a separate character with a full standalone silhouette at comparable scale. Art direction: richly tactile dark charcoal-plum satin clay with soft highlights, round organic goo bodies and short goo hands. Equipment rests directly against the clay body with chunky rounded shapes. Keep each full face unobstructed, including white ivory sclera, distinct red iris and black pupil, dark sculpted lids and dark ink lips. Protective hoods have wide open face rings or a clear visor raised above the forehead. Two subtly female-read figures in cells 2 and 5. Mouth and body silhouette vary deliberately. Teeth sit within an open mouth. No human torso, legs, boots or rigid armor. Props: a Hypernormalization Screen is a little portable slab the character holds beside its body, with dark smoked glass and a chunky rim. A dangerous card is a sealed abstract blank card with one tiny dark corner mark. No lettering. Keep all silhouettes including droplets and equipment in their cells, with generous air around each. Row-major direction:
1. Male-read skeptical leak assessor. small capped detector puck with one mint inset. tall egg blob, lifted brow and pursed mouth.
2. Female-read decisive seal technician. thick mint wedge-shaped plug held vertically. wide bell blob, focused asymmetric stare.
3. Male-read wry absorbent carrier. small cloth sack with a plain cream clasp. squat round blob, half lids and crooked smile.
4. Male-read carefully prepared recovery lead. shallow sealed catch tray tilted low at belly. broad soft square, tense mouth and steady eyes.
5. Female-read strict boundary specialist. compact petrol-blue Hypernormalization Screen with opaque slate glass and mint latch. lean curve blob with stern side glance.
6. Male-read mildly anxious evidence courier. two small sealed capped vials bundled in one holder. scalloped pear blob, wide unequal eyes.
Make the theme readable at thumbnail size. Render all six as independent character cutouts with true alpha.

material_change: Same accepted gentle charcoal/plum satin clay direction; no stronger correction and no generated style parent.
